name: beethoven
description: Start, watch and stop your Claude Code worker on your university's grid, and read its workspace, over your own ssh sign-in.

grid_account.title: Your grid account name
grid_account.description: The name you sign in to the grid with (at Wayne State, your AccessID, like ab1234). Not a password: Beethoven never asks for one.

site.title: Your university's grid
site.description: The site profile: wayne is Wayne State's grid.

worker_name.title: Worker name
worker_name.description: Which of your workers the tools use when you don't name one.

use_wsl.title: Use WSL's ssh (Windows only)
use_wsl.description: Windows' own ssh can't keep one sign-in for every request; WSL's ssh can. Needs WSL with a Linux distribution that has the OpenSSH client.
